_comment: Copy to hosts.json. A token is NEVER written here — name it with tokenEnv
(an env var) or tokenOp ('<vault>/<item-id>[/<field>]', resolved through the
1Password CLI inside the bridge process, so it never reaches a command line).
url is even-terminal's listener on that machine, reachable from wherever the
bridge runs — a tailnet address is the usual answer. Port 3457 rather than
the default 3456, which collides with other tooling.
A host that is unreachable simply contributes no sessions; it never fails
the list, because an ad-hoc even-terminal on a laptop is offline most of the
